about.title: About Me
about.presentation: I’m a full-stack developer who loves to build modern and intuitive applications. I started my journey a little over 2 years ago, first through Codecademy’s Full-Stack Engineer path, before completing the Application Developer and Designer program (RNCP level 6) at O’Clock, a school based in Paris. My main tech stack includes TypeScript (React, Next.js, Node.js) and Python (FastAPI), but I’m also open to working with other technologies as needed. I care deeply about clean code: tests, SOLID principles, and maintainable architecture. I also work on integrating AI tools into my web and mobile applications, with the goal of building modern, useful, and intuitive solutions.
about.background: Before getting into development, I worked for several years as an automotive electrician - installing new equipment, programming vehicles, and troubleshooting electrical systems. It’s where I built a strong foundation in logical thinking, problem-solving, and teamwork. Since then, I’ve shifted into full-stack web development, combining my technical background with a passion for building digital tools and apps. I'm always open to new opportunities, collaborations, or ideas - feel free to reach out!

projects.title: Projects
projects.prilot: A GitHub App that automatically generates pull request titles and descriptions from file diffs using AI, with ultra-fast generation powered by Cerebras. Integrated directly with the GitHub API to get compare data, create and push PRs. Supports multi-account connections (personal + organizations), team collaboration with invite-based access, and leverages Redis for caching and rate limiting.
projects.traduxo: A Next.js web app providing AI-powered, native-like translations with idiomatic suggestions and real-world explanations via the Gemini API, also available as a React Native mobile app. Users can type or speak text, access translation history, and save favorites. Highlights AI integration, advanced translation features, and a responsive UI. Deployed on a Hetzner VPS with Docker, using Nginx and Cloudflare reverse proxy, with a CI/CD pipeline for automated deployments.
projects.blablabook: A full-stack web application built with Next.js, Express.js, and PostgreSQL, developed collaboratively by a team of four during my IT course at O’Clock School. The platform allows users to manage their personal book library by adding books and tracking reading statuses. Users can enrich the global catalog via the Google Books API when a title is missing. The app includes social features such as book comments and threaded replies, gamification elements (badges and levels), and a personalized book recommendation algorithm.
